slides.notes: No title. Rephrase the user intent into concise presentation language instead of copying their draft. Adaptation to changing networks motivates the research; current class-arrival tests do not establish network-drift robustness.

slides.title: TabPFN · 표 데이터 예측 규칙을 사전학습한 모델 (v3: arXiv, 2026)
slides.notes: Source: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.13986 §2.5, PDF page 10: more than 8 trillion tokens, not datasets. Official TabPFN 8.2.0: https://github.com/PriorLabs/TabPFN/blob/main/src/tabpfn/finetuning/finetuned_base.py. EXP77 actually fine-tunes the initial IDS data using AdamW, learning rate 1e-5, 10 fixed epochs, context/query cross-entropy; then freezes weights. The v3 decoder weights context one-hot labels, so old-class examples remain necessary in the inference context. Validation is inside the 1000 revealed-label budget; no test tuning.

slides.title: v3 구조
slides.notes: Original Figure 5, https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.13986#page=6. Native PPTX crop excludes the original caption. Labels and source remain in speaker notes. First three stages: feature grouping/cell embedding; target-aware column distribution embedding; row-level feature aggregation. Plain language deliberately omits implementation dimensions.

slides.title: v3 구조
slides.notes: Same Figure 5, https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.13986#page=6; no visible caption by user request. ICL attends to training/context keys; many-class decoder uses attention-weighted one-hot context labels. This is learned contextual relevance, not merely raw-feature nearest-neighbour distance. Context determines available class labels.

slides.title: 평가시나리오
slides.notes: EXP77 uses the same released IDs as EXP76. Initial IDS weight fine-tuning: fixed 10 epochs, AdamW, lr 1e-5; initial internal feature-group validation only. Subsequent context policies freeze the initial checkpoint; repeated FT is a separate control. XGB cumulatively retrains. Proposed model uses five feature-disjoint roles within the SAME total label budget, original pretrained backbone to keep calibration labels outside weight training. Stage order chronological, within-stage sample counts descending. Main score is the FINAL state on ALL held-out rows, not pooled stage predictions.

slides.title: 결과
slides.notes: EXP77 final-model full-test results: tabpfn/results/v7/exp77/20261015_230535_initialft10_finalfull_s43_2eb2237d/results.json. Two displayed methods: XGB cumulative retraining from scratch at every stage and original pretrained TabPFN with cumulative context, no IDS fine-tuning. Initial-FT results are retained in EXP77/EXP78, removed from slides 6 and 7 at user request. Slide 6 alone reports later-stage update cost: GPU-synchronized context selection + model construction + fit summed AFTER the initial stage; initial preparation and all inference excluded. Single seed 43. A separate EXP78 label-budget artifact covers 100/50/20/10 new examples per class, with initial 1000 fixed.

slides.title: 제안 모델·SOTA 성능 비교
slides.notes: Same EXP77 released-label budget: CIC2018 1400 / ToN 1700, including all internal validation and calibration. Only final full-test Macro-F1 is displayed; all cost panels and initial-FT baseline removed per user request. Existing K=4 anchor/residual + S1V0 proposed model uses original pretrained weights and global/expert/route/tune/cal roles within that total budget. Both datasets have zero expert calls in the final evaluation, so this is a diagnosed current configuration, not demonstrated ensemble improvement. Candidate expert corrections changed correctness on at most 0/4 calibration rows (CIC2018/ToN), below the existing 30-case requirement. Next diagnostic controls are a single PFN with identical Global context and adjustment of shared anchors/expert-specific allocation; do not retune thresholds on test. BoostPFN is the existing 50-learner port. DistPFN uses original pretrained v3 without IDS FT and current-query-batch posterior adjustment; no query labels. Historical 1014 results have a different 100k budget and pooled replay evaluation and are not inserted into the current final-state comparison. Source: tabpfn/results/v7/exp78/20261016_005435_noft_dist_new100_50_20_10_s43_52588487/dist_results.json
